verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's internal status pages give stakeholders a no-login view of structured incident updates (posted via Slack `/fh update` or Command Center) without joining the incident channel/bridge, and external status pages extend this further (firehydrant-docs-15, firehydrant-docs-36, firehydrant-docs-65, firehydrant-docs-16). However, the evidence never describes a subscribe/notify mechanism (e.g., email/SMS/RSS subscription) for stakeholders to get pushed updates rather than having to check the page. Missing for 10: explicit subscription/notification feature for status page followers, and independent confirmation that non-technical stakeholders actually use this to stay out of the war room.
